research_question: Can the confirmed Stage26d adaptive gate be evaluated online and stop at its first qualifying 10-block window so that the exact fixed-fibre equilibrium state is saved and independently reload-verified?
claim_boundary: Dry fixed-fibre state-capture method only. No fibre release, free-fibre stability, polymer calibration, permeability, flow, deformation, migration, transient FSI, or production concentration effect.

evidence_allocation_frozen_before_execut.candidate05: development of online event detection, checkpoint publication, and reload verification
evidence_allocation_frozen_before_execut.candidate07: one-shot held-out confirmation of the frozen capture implementation
evidence_allocation_frozen_before_execut.candidate08: untouched reserve for a later, separately designed free-release validation
evidence_allocation_frozen_before_execut.candidate01: spent Stage26d development evidence; unavailable as independent evidence
evidence_allocation_frozen_before_execut.candidate04: spent Stage26d held-out evidence; rerun prohibited

frozen_capture_protocol.capture_event: Immediately after the tenth consecutive passing diagnostic row, before any further YADE step, save one checkpoint and terminate the run.
frozen_capture_protocol.checkpoint_rule: Exactly one state file; SHA-256-bound result and completion; no checkpoint if the gate is not reached.
frozen_capture_protocol.reload_rule: A separate immutable YADE process must reload the state, take zero integration steps, recompute the full diagnostic, reproduce the captured row within frozen tolerances, and publish no modified state.

sequential_handoff: implement and unit-test the capture and reload-verification logic
audit its saved-state and reload bundle
freeze implementation hashes without tuning physics or gates
stop before any free release and preserve candidate08

failure_rules.resource_ceiling: No qualifying window by block 300 produces no saved state and fails that geometry.
failure_rules.engagement: Any complete loss of contacts or declared anchors fails the geometry and produces no saved state.
failure_rules.state_publication: Any missing, extra, mutable, or hash-mismatched state file fails closed.
failure_rules.reload: Any diagnostic mismatch fails state promotion and prohibits release.
failure_rules.heldout: Candidate07 may run once only and cannot be retuned or rerun as independent evidence.
